title: Ty Simpson reveals 'secret meeting' with Rams, Sean McVay before 2026 NFL Draft

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ty Simpson reveals 'secret meeting' with Rams, Sean McVay before 2026 NFL Draft
sources.description: Ty Simpson initially said he hadn't met Sean McVay before the 2026 NFL Draft, but the QB revealed he had a secret meeting with the Rams coach.
